e.body:
**ASSA（Actuarial Society of South Africa，南非精算师协会）** 是**南非的精算专业团体**，也是本轮市场覆盖轴的一部分——实测池内**南非相关条目为 0**。可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：首页 122KB；**资格路径页 `/qualification-roadmap/`** 150KB，页内实测到**科目与 IFoA 代码的对应关系**，例如 **A111: Actuarial Statistics ↔ IFoA Subject Code CS1**、**A112: Business Economics ↔ IFoA Subject Code CB2**——即 **ASSA 的考试与 IFoA（英国精算师协会）联考/互认**（首页亦列有 "IFoA Coordinated Exams" 与 "ASSA Open Book Exams (F200)" 入口）；**历年考卷 `/document-category/past-paper/`** 104KB；**指引准则与专业标准 `/document-category/guidance-notes/`** 104KB；**专业资源与操守 `/professional-resources-and-conduct/`** 143KB（含执业证书 Practising Certificates、终身学习等）；**公益研究 `/public-benefits-research/`** 207KB；成绩与合格者另设门户 `results.actuarialsociety.org.za`。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「南非」这一整块空白，并且它是一个真实可用的资格路径**——对考虑在英联邦体系内发展、或研究**非洲保险与养老金市场**的学生，ASSA 是入口；**② 与 IFoA 的对应关系有具体的教学价值**：池内已有 [[ifoa]]、[[ifoa-studying]]、[[ifoa-formulae-tables]]（IFoA 公式与表），**ASSA 把「同一门考试在南非叫什么、对应 IFoA 哪一科」写清楚了**，这对**跨体系备考与免考评估**是直接可用的信息；**③ 公开资源可直接用**——历年考卷、指引准则、公益研究三类都是开放页面，可与池内 [[actuarial-exam-database]]、[[open-exam-prep]]、[[soa-education]]、[[cas-syllabus]]、[[cii]]、[[anziif]]、[[loma]]、[[actuarial-open-book]] 并列使用。**④ 与其他专业团体的对照**——[[actuaries-institute]]、[[singapore-actuarial-society]]、[[china-actuarial-association]]、[[peak-exam-centre]]、[[mpfe]]、[[ashk-examination]]、[[insurance-exam-bank-cn]] 构成「**各市场的资格与考试体系**」这一族，ASSA 在此之前是缺的。**⑤ 数据侧关联**——ASSA 所处的南非市场另有监管侧数据（见 [[fsca]]），而人口/死亡率方法论侧可对照 [[human-mortality-db]]、[[mortsoa]]、[[mortalitytables]]、[[cmi-mortality-projections]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到的是**页面结构与资格路径正文**（含 IFoA 科目代码对应的实测文本），**未逐份打开考卷、指引准则与研究文档**；**②** 公开的考卷与准则**主要面向南非体系**，对香港/内地学生的直接用途是**跨体系对照**而非替代本地路径；**③** 本站为**专业团体站点**，**不含保险市场统计数据**（数据侧请看同一市场的 [[fsca]]）；**④** 会员资格、费用与免考政策**以官方最新公告为准**，本词条不转述具体条款。**核实说明**：首页（122KB）、资格路径（150KB）、历年考卷（104KB）、指引准则（104KB）、专业资源（143KB）、公益研究（207KB）均 HTTP 200 实测；**未下载或打开个别文档**。
e.body_en:
**ASSA (Actuarial Society of South Africa)** is **South Africa’s actuarial professional body**, and part of this round’s market-coverage axis — a measured search found **zero South Africa-related entries** in the corpus. Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): homepage 122KB; the **qualification roadmap page `/qualification-roadmap/`** is 150KB and its text contains **subject-to-IFoA-code mappings**, for example **A111: Actuarial Statistics ↔ IFoA Subject Code CS1** and **A112: Business Economics ↔ IFoA Subject Code CB2** — i.e. **ASSA’s examinations are coordinated with the IFoA** (the homepage also lists "IFoA Coordinated Exams" and "ASSA Open Book Exams (F200)"); **past exam papers `/document-category/past-paper/`** 104KB; **guidance notes and professional standards `/document-category/guidance-notes/`** 104KB; **professional resources and conduct `/professional-resources-and-conduct/`** 143KB (including practising certificates and lifelong learning); **public-benefit research `/public-benefits-research/`** 207KB; results and qualifiers live on a separate portal, `results.actuarialsociety.org.za`.

For RIAA: **① it fills an entire missing market (South Africa) with something genuinely usable — a qualification pathway** — so for students considering a Commonwealth actuarial track or researching **African insurance and pension markets**, ASSA is the entry point; **② the IFoA mapping has concrete teaching value**: the corpus already holds [[ifoa]], [[ifoa-studying]] and [[ifoa-formulae-tables]] (IFoA formulae and tables), and **ASSA spells out what the same examination is called in South Africa and which IFoA subject it corresponds to**, which is directly usable for **cross-system study planning and exemption assessment**; **③ open resources are usable as-is** — past papers, guidance notes and public-benefit research are all open pages, sitting alongside [[actuarial-exam-database]], [[open-exam-prep]], [[soa-education]], [[cas-syllabus]], [[cii]], [[anziif]], [[loma]] and [[actuarial-open-book]]. **④ Comparison with other bodies** — [[actuaries-institute]], [[singapore-actuarial-society]], [[china-actuarial-association]], [[peak-exam-centre]], [[mpfe]], [[ashk-examination]] and [[insurance-exam-bank-cn]] form the "**qualification and examination systems by market**" family, in which ASSA was previously missing. **⑤ Data-side links** — South Africa’s regulatory data is covered by [[fsca]], while population/mortality methodology can be read against [[human-mortality-db]], [[mortsoa]], [[mortalitytables]] and [[cmi-mortality-projections]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check reached the **page structures and the roadmap body text** (including the measured IFoA subject-code mappings) and **did not open individual papers, guidance notes or research documents**; **②** the public papers and standards **serve the South African system**, so for Hong Kong or mainland students their direct use is **cross-system comparison**, not a substitute for a local pathway; **③** this is a **professional body site and carries no insurance market statistics** (for data see [[fsca]] in the same market); **④** membership, fees and exemption policy **are governed by the latest official notices**, and this entry does not restate specific terms. **Verification note**: the homepage (122KB), qualification roadmap (150KB), past papers (104KB), guidance notes (104KB), professional resources (143KB) and public-benefit research (207KB) were all measured at HTTP 200; **no individual document was downloaded or opened**.
e.body_hk:
**ASSA（Actuarial Society of South Africa，南非精算師協會）** 是**南非的精算專業團體**，也是本輪市場覆蓋軸的一部分——實測池內**南非相關條目為 0**。可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 122KB；**資格路徑頁** 150KB，頁內實測到**科目與 IFoA 代碼的對應**（**A111: Actuarial Statistics ↔ IFoA CS1**、**A112: Business Economics ↔ IFoA CB2**）——即 **ASSA 的考試與 IFoA 聯考/互認**（首頁亦列有 "IFoA Coordinated Exams"）；**歷年考卷頁** 104KB；**指引準則頁** 104KB；**專業資源與操守頁** 143KB；**公益研究頁** 207KB；成績與合格者另設門戶 `results.actuarialsociety.org.za`。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「南非」這一整塊空白，並且是一個真實可用的資格路徑**；**② 與 IFoA 的對應關係有具體教學價值**——池內已有 [[ifoa]]、[[ifoa-studying]]、[[ifoa-formulae-tables]]，而 ASSA 把「同一門考試在南非叫什麼、對應 IFoA 哪一科」寫清楚，對**跨體系備考與免考評估**直接可用；**③ 公開資源可直接用**（歷年考卷、指引準則、公益研究），可與 [[actuarial-exam-database]]、[[open-exam-prep]]、[[soa-education]]、[[cas-syllabus]]、[[cii]]、[[anziif]]、[[loma]]、[[actuarial-open-book]] 並列；**④ 與其他專業團體對照**——[[actuaries-institute]]、[[singapore-actuarial-society]]、[[china-actuarial-association]]、[[peak-exam-centre]]、[[mpfe]]、[[ashk-examination]]、[[insurance-exam-bank-cn]] 構成「**各市場資格與考試體系**」一族，ASSA 此前缺失；**⑤ 數據側**見同市場的 [[fsca]]，方法論側可對照 [[human-mortality-db]]、[[mortsoa]]、[[mortalitytables]]、[[cmi-mortality-projections]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面結構與資格路徑正文**，**未逐份打開考卷、指引準則與研究文檔**；**②** 公開考卷與準則**主要面向南非體系**，對港/內地學生的直接用途是**跨體系對照**；**③** 本站為**專業團體站點，不含保險市場統計**（數據側見 [[fsca]]）；**④** 會員資格、費用與免考政策**以官方最新公告為準**。**核實說明**：首頁、資格路徑、歷年考卷、指引準則、專業資源、公益研究頁均 HTTP 200 實測；**未下載或打開個別文檔**。
